searchText: <@755590043632140352> I have two remarks: * Why exactly would just storing the PTC for the last slot of the previous epoch be uglier? > We could do this by keeping only one PTC, that of the last slot of the previous epoch, in the state, but that's even uglier. * I feel that "lookbehind" is a bit misleading in both PRs, since they include the current slot/epoch's PTC too. Would you be open to changing this? Not sure what would be better, maybe `ptc_cache`? Ah I found the answer to this in the first PR: > yes, this is an option that was proposed, it's also possible to have it of size 1! but they both look pretty ugly to me. It forces clients (and spec) to have special cases per slots. Both testing and implementations become more fragile by this I believe. I would also like to define `PTC_CACHE_PREVIOUS_SLOT_INDEX` (0) and `PTC_CACHE_CURRENT_SLOT_INDEX` (1) constants. Such a change would look like: https://gist.github.com/jtraglia/8c8386ddfc3bf51c7d5d949f74f1c758 <@&1417820113981145228> :whip: <@199561711278227457> can you pls add <@641548687813902336> to glamsterdam-cl role pls wanna make sure in my next whip message I get to ping him too directly 😂 also pls add <@358120958726373381> <@737658693331714159> if you do this then you may as well remove the Vector[Vector,2]] and just keep the previous PTC and current PTC in the state separately as I said in the comment It's less verbose than having to deal with extra named constant then for specrefs Yeah I'd be fine with that too. Just pushed this change. I kinda liked the "lookbehind" part, made it more obvious what it is required/used for but PR looks good to me either way

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content:
* Why exactly would just storing the PTC for the last slot of the previous epoch be uglier?
> We could do this by keeping only one PTC, that of the last slot of the previous epoch, in the state, but that's even uglier.

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: * I feel that "lookbehind" is a bit misleading in both PRs, since they include the current slot/epoch's PTC too. Would you be open to changing this? Not sure what would be better, maybe `ptc_cache`?

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content:
Ah I found the answer to this in the first PR:
> yes, this is an option that was proposed, it's also possible to have it of size 1! but they both look pretty ugly to me. It forces clients (and spec) to have special cases per slots. Both testing and implementations become more fragile by this I believe.

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: I would also like to define `PTC_CACHE_PREVIOUS_SLOT_INDEX` (0) and `PTC_CACHE_CURRENT_SLOT_INDEX` (1) constants.
